name: Valdemoro-Sierra (Spain)
description: Quartered white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdemoro-Sierra (a mountain and a tree above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Valdemoro-Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdemoro-Sierra arms — mountain and tree above waves
